Materialised per instance. The node the generator hangs dcat:startDate and dcat:endDate on is the time-span itself; without the type a CRM consumer sees P4 pointing at something untyped. Repeatable, so all four descriptions per FDO (A1, Befund 5) are carried and none is chosen. Which of them is the real description is a question for the quality report, not for the mapping.

The FDO refers to the place; it does not happen there, so P7 took place at would be wrong - an information object is not an event. The object is typed crm:E53_Place by the object-class row below.

Types the object of dct:spatial, which is an OpenStreetMap IRI in every package. Per instance, never as an axiom: nothing is asserted here about what OpenStreetMap relations are in general, only that these seven are places. Without it P67_refers_to points at an untyped node.
